pattern: poll for a change, wake only when it happens
experience: The user wants a frequent task that only bothers the agent when something changed. The agent schedules it and gives it a check script that exits 10 when nothing changed, then tells the user the script needs their approval.
rule: set_scheduled_task_check: Gate a scheduled task with a check script so runs wake you only when there is work ... Runs only once the user approves it: tell them.
